verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes a programmatic XML API with a separate sandbox endpoint for safe testing. An official Terraform provider manages DNS as code and can auto-detect the caller's IP, which helps on CI runners. An official Go SDK covers domain check, register, renew and lock operations, and a documented HTTPS dynamic-DNS update endpoint is corroborated by a community user. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/headless setup guidance (e.g. API key and IP-whitelisting in ephemeral runners), and independent hands-on reports of CI pipeline use.
